notes.title: Release Date Announcement for Read Only Memories NEURODIVER!
notes.notes:
Kept you waiting, huh?

[previewyoutube=-ljJbTUUfBA;full][/previewyoutube]
May 16th, 2024 A.D. marks the launch of Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/162fb05f943f1e9326547686a72a4f3ced8c2f33.png
That's right, you saw it here first (maybe)! Join ES88 as she hunts down the elusive psychic entity, Golden Butterfly, on May 16th! We've had many release windows in the past, all of which we'll admit were pretty ambitious, but this is it! We can't miss it! It's set in stone! That stone is really, really difficult to chip in another date! We've tried!

Now hold your horses. Before you close this email, we have to inform you that the Good News Train doesn't stop there. On top of the game's digital release announcement, you'll also be able to pre-order both the Standard and Collector's Editions in physical form RIGHT HERE, RIGHT NOW for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5. But wait, there’s more! Our good friends at Serenity Forge are also announcing Neurodiver tees featuring Rebecca Ryan’s stunning artwork you see above, AND a gorgeous reprint of 2064: Read Only Memories. Phew!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/d9a792e62eea4b64335e37d8a7acc2f935b79e48.png
The Standard Edition will include a full manual and soundtrack download code, while the Collector's Edition will include a full color art book, holographic stickers, an acrylic charm of ES88, and your very own Neurodiver to take care of and love (in plush form only).

We'd like to thank you for all of your patience with us over the years with this project, and we're thrilled to finally reach the end of our long journey of building this world for you to experience.

The Long and Short of It:


 Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER launches on May 16th
     > For Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox

 Pre-Orders for physical Standard and Collector's Editions, tees, and 2064 reprints are available NOW.

 Wishlist us on Steam if you haven't already!

 Check out the demo, Pilot Memory, on Steam now!
     > This'll be updated with some newer graphics and VO in the full game!

And that's it! Thank you so much again for your patience and we hope to see you in Neo-San Francisco on May 16th!

- MidBoss
